items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: when I played Carnegie Hall in 2013 with the New York Pops, Bucky came up and guested with us

ctx.x: Yes I think so. I mean there’s — the stories about him are — have been around forever. And everybody seems to have one. Every once in a while you talk to somebody like Bucky Pizzarelli never had an issue with Benny Goodman. He just liked him a lot and they got along swell.

Yeah, well I’ve — I was on the road with Bucky for a little bit too, and Peter Appleyard, and I watched those interviews that you did with them years ago, and Bucky and Peter loved him. And I think one of the reasons they did, and because Benny is my hero, I’ve © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

read everything I could on him and read it a hundred times over, just ‘cause it’s an interest of mine. What I can gather about Benny was I think he probably felt he needed to protect himself from the world, and I think that aloofness that people talk about, I think he was totally aware of what he was doing, it was just a way to keep people out. But Peter and Bucky, from what I understand, probably put him at ease. You know? And I think that maybe Benny was able to let his guard down a little bit more and be open…
